# template/v1 vectors

Verbatim copies of `pkg/template/testdata/vectors/v1/*.json` from
[arkade-os/executor](https://github.com/arkade-os/executor) at commit
`a7e9ced51f861cd4dc8feb03fe5b16baf03582cb` (tag `v0.0.6-rc.1`), taken from the git blobs (LF).

Do not edit them. To update, copy the new commit's blobs and record it here.
